home.subtitle: Connect. Learn. Teach.
home.heroDescription: Join a community of continuous learners. Exchange your expertise through live video sessions, earn points, and grow without limits.
home.waitlistSuccess: You're on the list! Check your email for confirmation.
home.waitlistError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: From profile setup to skill mastery in five simple steps.
home.step1Desc: Set up your skills — what you can teach and what you want to learn. Add your bio and experience level.
home.step2Desc: Browse users with complementary skills or get automatically matched with the perfect exchange partner.
home.step3Desc: Send a request with session terms — skill-for-skill swap, points, or a combination. Negotiate until both sides agree.
home.step4Desc: Join a real-time HD video session with in-session chat, screen sharing, and optional recording.
home.step5Desc: Rate your exchange partner, earn reputation, and unlock new opportunities with every session.
home.featuresTitle: Everything You Need to Exchange Skills
home.featuresSubtitle: A complete platform designed for seamless peer-to-peer learning.
home.featureExchangeDesc: Trade your expertise for new knowledge — no money required. Pure value exchange between learners.
home.featureVideoDesc: HD video calls with screen sharing, powered by LiveKit for crystal-clear teaching sessions.
home.featurePointsDesc: Earn and spend points to unlock premium exchanges. Buy points or earn them through referrals.
home.featureMatchingDesc: Find complementary skill holders automatically. We match you with the best exchange partners.
home.featureRecordingDesc: Record sessions for later review with mutual consent. Never miss a learning moment.
home.featureChatDesc: Real-time messaging during video sessions. Share links, code snippets, and resources.
home.featureSchedulingDesc: Propose time slots and coordinate seamlessly. Find a time that works for both parties.
home.featureReviewsDesc: Build your reputation with detailed ratings and tags like "Great Teacher" and "Patient".
home.featureReferralDesc: Earn 200 points per referral, plus ongoing bonuses for every exchange your referrals make.
home.pointsSubtitle: A fair, transparent system that powers skill exchanges.
home.pointsPurchaseDesc: Buy points with real money via secure payment
home.pointsExchangeDesc: Use points to balance unequal skill swaps
home.pointsEscrowDesc: Points are held safely until the session completes
home.pointsWithdrawDesc: Convert your earned points back to real money
home.platformSubtitle: Use Skill Exchange on any device, in your language.
home.platformWebDesc: Works in any browser. Install it like a native app.
home.platformAndroidDesc: Native mobile experience built with React Native.
home.platformLanguagesDesc: Available in English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese.
home.trustSubtitle: A secure, reliable platform built with the tools trusted by the best teams.
home.trustSecureDesc: End-to-end video, consent-based recording, and email verification keep you safe.
home.trustEscrowDesc: Points are locked in escrow during exchanges — both parties are protected.
home.trustOpenDesc: Built with Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, LiveKit, and Prisma for reliability.
home.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about Skill Exchange.
home.faq1A: Yes! You can exchange skills for free through direct skill-for-skill swaps. Points are optional and used when you want to balance an unequal exchange or access premium features.
home.faq2A: Points are the platform's currency. You can purchase them, earn them through referrals, or receive them from exchanges. They're used to compensate partners when a pure skill swap isn't possible.
home.faq3Q: What happens during a live session?
home.faq3A: You join an HD video call with your exchange partner. You can share your screen, use the in-session chat, and optionally record the session (with both parties' consent) for later review.
home.faq4A: Yes, with mutual consent. Both participants must agree before recording starts. Recordings are stored securely and available for review for a limited time.
home.faq5Q: How does the referral program work?
home.faq5A: Share your unique referral code with friends. When they sign up and complete their first exchange, you both earn 200 points. You also earn ongoing bonuses for their future exchanges.
home.faq6Q: What languages is the platform available in?
home.faq6A: Skill Exchange is available in English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese. We're working on adding more languages soon.
home.faq7A: We're putting the finishing touches on the platform. Join the waitlist to be notified when we launch, or set up your profile early so you're ready on day one!
home.ctaTitle: Be the first to trade skills
home.ctaSubtitle: Join the waitlist and get early access when we launch.
home.ctaOrSetup: Or set up your profile now →
home.footerTagline: Learn, Teach, Grow. Swap skills and knowledge securely.
home.comingSoonDesc: This feature is launching soon. Set up your profile so you're ready!
